unresolvedReview.notice: Published with unresolved editorial review findings, listed below. The review ran and recorded them; since 2026-08-04 a stylistic or topical finding does not stop publication. The checks that the article is accurate still do: supplied source links, cited sources, source diversity, primary sourcing, watchlist support and the cost caps.

verdicts.reason: Close-up of cooling hardware and components on a working motherboard—concrete, well-lit, no faces or distracting text, directly illustrates the physical systems underlying AI models.

candidates.reason: Shows real hands working with actual computer hardware in a practical context, illustrating AI systems' physical substrate, though the specific motherboard model is identifiable.

candidates.reason: This circuit-board brain has become a visual cliché for AI coverage and reads as a generic stock illustration rather than honest documentation of the topic.

candidates.reason: Museum or educational display of computer hardware with visitors observing—relevant to tech history and AI infrastructure, though somewhat distant from current AI problems.

candidates.reason: A close-up of a person's face and hand with digital effects is unsuitable; the recognisable face is disqualifying even before the synthetic aesthetic raises additional concerns.
